title: C# Questions & Answers - Rounding Functions
sourceFile: Rounding Functions - C# Questions & Answers - Sanfoundry.html
description: This section of our 1000+ C# MCQs focuses on rounding functions in C# Programming Language.

questions.question: Which among the given classes provides types of rounding functions?
questions.explanation: System.Math provides Round, Floor, Ceiling, Truncate, and related methods.

questions.question: Which of these methods is a rounding function of Math class?
questions.explanation: Math.Round rounds to the nearest integer or to a given number of fractional digits. It does not always round up; midpoint behavior depends on the overload (ToEven vs AwayFromZero). Max, Min, and Abs are not rounding functions.

questions.question: Which of these classes contains mathematical functions such as Sin, Pow, and Sqrt?
questions.explanation: Math is the class for these functions. It is not limited to floating-point arguments: several methods also have integer overloads.

questions.question: Which of these methods returns the smallest whole number greater than or equal to x?
questions.explanation: Math.Ceiling(x) is the smallest integer greater than or equal to x (as a double). The name is Ceiling, not Ciel. Math.Max/Min need two arguments.

questions.question: Which of these methods return a largest whole number less than or equal to variable X?
questions.explanation: Math.Floor(x) is the largest integer less than or equal to x.

questions.question: Which of the following functions return absolute value of a variable?
questions.explanation: Math.Abs returns the absolute value. There is no Math.Absolute method.
